validity.introduced_by: a merge commit on taiyun668/gogoke main whose GitHub merged_by is taiyun668

supersedes.reason: Owner 2026-10-06 replaces manual CLI installation and upgrade with gogoke-managed fixed official CLI lifecycle, extends host-backed instance management, and adds the fourth right-side Seats slot through seven exact integrator-owned shared paths. This one scope-changing plan and receipt take effect only after the Owner merges the same PR and Controller verifies main; no new Owner touchpoint is added.

plan.stale_when: the scope digest of the plan in force differs from the value above

start_condition: Owner merges the PR that carries this receipt; Controller then reads back the actual merge, the receipt bytes, and recomputes the scope digest of main's PLAN.json with main's verifier before continuing
owner_touchpoints: The bound PLAN.json retains its planned and conditional Owner decisions; this receipt does not complete them
amendment_rule: An amendment that leaves the scope digest unchanged changes only details (phase placement and milestone notes, deliverable, contract and check descriptions, assets, source pins); it never widens write scope, adds a shared file, changes contract ownership or a recorded Owner decision. Independent review must preserve requirements, invariants and security. It takes effect when an independent audit passes and the Controller merges the plan PR; no new receipt and no Owner merge. An amendment that changes the scope digest carries the updated receipt in the same PR, and the Owner merges that one PR.
owner_direction: Gogoke itself installs and manages each fixed official CLI; no user global npm discovery. Host-managed install, explicit upgrade and rollback, update check, doctor and zero-instance uninstall; version changes refuse active or UNKNOWN holders or sessions. Instance management and source-backed read models follow the 2026-10-06 Owner direction; B5 unsupported account isolation is unchanged. The current project gains a fourth right-side Seats tab with real host SeatsSource or an explicit not-connected state, exact host-backed seat fields, qualified choices and distinct K-SEAT actions; no new login or authorization touchpoint.
